description: Add GitHub Actions CI workflow with npm ci, architecture check, test suite, and frontend build drift check
steps: Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with a workflow triggered on push and pull_request to main
Use Node.js 22.x in the workflow (matching engines requirement >=22.18.0)
Steps: checkout, setup-node with cache npm, npm ci, npm run check:architecture, npm test, frontend build drift check
Frontend build drift check: run `npm run build:frontend --workspace=ajun-runtime` then `git diff --exit-code apps/ajun-runtime/public/` to fail if compiled JS is stale
Also add the any-density gate script as a step (will be created in FEAT-003)
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/ci.yml exists with valid GitHub Actions syntax
Workflow includes steps: checkout, setup-node, npm ci, architecture check, tests, frontend drift check
The drift check step runs build:frontend then git diff --exit-code on public/ directory
verification: Validate YAML syntax by reading the file
npm run check passes (CI file doesn't break existing build)
findings: CI workflow created successfully. npm run check and npm test both pass. Note: FEAT-003 (check-any-density.mjs) was being developed concurrently - the CI workflow references the script which will exist by the time CI runs. The package.json already has a check:any-density script added by another agent.
